purpose: Validate the exact definition evidence and construct an immutable, source-ordered four-slot symbolic AST without interpreting scientific content or defining runtime slot semantics.

required.statement: Accept exactly scientific object identities TLC-SO-MESSAGE-002, TLC-SO-MESSAGE-003, and TLC-SO-MESSAGE-025 as distinct evidence.
Preserve the formal Message expression as an opaque four-slot expression in source order.
Return one traceable AST root with exactly four source-named symbolic slots and all three evidence references.
Preserve candidate status, provenance, opaque payloads, and reservation TLC-DUP-MESSAGE-001.

forbidden.statement: Do not evaluate, execute, normalize, translate, or scientifically complete any slot content.
Do not invent slot runtime types, encoding, transport, sender or receiver interfaces, layout, timing, or numerical behavior.
Do not merge the three evidence identities or reorder the four symbolic slots.
Do not expose a successful partial AST after validation or preservation failure.

deferred.statement: Concrete runtime representations for the four slots remain implementation-defined and scientifically unresolved.
Encoding, transport, execution semantics, and the scientific resolution of TLC-DUP-MESSAGE-001 remain outside this package.

operations.purpose: Construct the structural AST for the exact source-declared Message quadruplet.

inputs.name: definition_evidence
inputs.semantic_role: exact candidate evidence and opaque formal expression

fields.name: formal_expression
fields.semantic_role: opaque source expression with four named slots

fields.name: source_references
fields.semantic_role: source ranges for evidence and expression

constraints.statement: object_ids contains exactly the three required identities, each once.
formal_expression preserves the source-named slots contenu, symbolique, structure_procedurale, and contexte in that order.
Opaque payload and source references are supplied unchanged.
The result is observable as immutable.
Exactly one root and exactly four source-ordered slots are present.
All three object identities, contextual references, opaque content, provenance, candidate status, and reservation are preserved.

preconditions.statement: The three required evidence identities and their source references are present exactly once.
The formal expression is present unchanged and exposes exactly four source-named slots.

postconditions.statement: A successful result has one Message tuple root and exactly four source-ordered symbolic slots.
The three evidence identities remain distinct, source-addressable, and unevaluated.
No scientific value, runtime type, protocol, or execution behavior has been added.

invariants.statement: Object identity, slot identity, slot order, opaque content, provenance, candidate status, and reservation are conserved.
The operation does not mutate scientific evidence or external domain state.

prescription_basis: Only validation, preservation, exact structure, and failure-before-success are observable; the upstream total step list is not a unique implementation algorithm.

error_contract.condition: A required evidence identity or source reference is missing.
The preserved formal expression does not expose exactly the four source-named slots in source order.

implementation_modes.statement: Expose the exact structural AST behavior and stable errors defined by this package.
Do not calculate, interpret, execute, or complete the four Message components.
Do not add encoding, sender, receiver, channel, delivery, or transport semantics.
Any internal architecture is allowed when every observable obligation and acceptance test remains satisfied.

global_invariants.statement: Absence of runtime and scientific semantics remains absence; it never becomes a default.
No implementation behavior may weaken exact identity, four-slot order, opacity, immutability, provenance, candidate status, or reservation preservation.

dependencies.purpose: Exact object, relation, and ordered-slot collections.
Non-interpretation of the formal expression and slot content.

notes: The dependency on TLC-FC-07-MESSAGE-006 is documentary and structural; this operation does not require executing that feature.
